image_description: A wide shot of a theatrical stage performance featuring seven individuals in elaborate, fantasy-style costumes (resembling anime or game characters). The stage is an elevated platform with a dark floor, illuminated by blue and white stage lights from an overhead truss system. A large LED screen serves as the backdrop. The foreground shows the edge of the stage and a blurred audience area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elevated rectangular platform, raised slightly above floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly depicts a raised platform distinct from the lower foreground area, consistent with a stage structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dimensions vary from small intimate platforms to large theatrical stages spanning the full width of a performance hall.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The stage spans the entire width of the frame and accommodates seven people comfortably, indicating a large theatrical scale.
The horizontal line separating the stage floor from the lower foreground is sharp and clearly visible across the bottom of the image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is covered with matte black flooring or painted wood.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The stage floor is dark and non-reflective (matte), consistent with standard stage flooring, though lit by blue spotlights.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Steps or ramps provide access from floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No steps or ramps are visible in this specific camera angle; access points are likely off-screen or obscured by the subjects.
A metal truss system with mounted lighting fixtures is clearly visible spanning the top of the image against the dark background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Constructed from wood or metal decking.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the material texture is obscured by lighting and distance, the structural rigidity and context imply standard wood/metal construction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows scuff marks from performances.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Image resolution and lighting conditions prevent the visualization of fine surface details like scuff marks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Side and rear may have wings or backdrop supports.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large digital backdrop/screen is visible behind the performers, serving the function of a rear backdrop.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the large screen behind the performers is illegible and distorted, appearing as abstract shapes rather than clear characters, which is a common AI artifact in rendering text.
Some fabric folds appear slightly smudged or overly smooth, lacking the crisp micro-texture expected from high-resolution photography of complex costumes.

artifact_observations.location: Hands and held props (far right figure)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The hands of the figure on the far right interacting with props appear somewhat fused or indistinct, lacking clear finger definition.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a 'stage' and not a generic concert hall or outdoor event.
To verify the physical separation between the elevated stage, the performers, and the background screen, ensuring no spatial bleeding.
To check for fusion artifacts between the complex costumes, props, and the stage floor, especially around the feet and hands.
To rigorously analyze the illegible text on the backdrop, confirming if it is gibberish or just low-resolution blur.
To assess global lighting consistency and identify any subtle generative noise or unnatural smoothing.

focus_areas: Integrity of the stage edge (proscenium) for geometric validity.
Clarity and structure of the overhead lighting truss.
Hand-prop interactions for potential fusion artifacts.
Foot-ground contact points for all performers.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact on the background screen. While common in real photos at distance, AI often generates specific 'pseudo-text' patterns. Verify if the distortion is optical (blur) or structural (nonsensical glyphs). Also, scrutinize the hands of the performers, particularly the one on the far right, as AI struggles with complex hand poses holding objects.
